segments.reason: TR13 refuted with a frequency-versus-severity contrast in S1.open_x1 and S1.open_x3; S1.open_ok offers a fast lane; S1.age_a_x and S1.age_bx explain the age rule. Weak: S1.open_2 and S1.age_a2 re-ask the same stem with 'Same question, one more look'; S1.age_a_t and S1.age_bt only say 'Try once more'.

Good TR4 and TR5 work: S2.pain_a_t1 and S2.chain_probe_t2 tempt then refute, S2.teach_pain and S2.chain_why explain, S2.sym_probe_t2 names fever as the late sign. Weak: S2.age_probe and S2.adult_probe repeat the S1.age_a and S1.age_b lesson a third and fourth time; S2.pain_a_2, S2.chain_probe_2, S2.end_probe_2 and S2.sym_probe_2 re-ask identical stems at once.

Richest trap work: S3.case_t1 and S3.rov_t3 use Tempting then Nudge; S3.rov predicts the press site before the answer; S3.pos_t1 and S3.mech_t2 separate TR2 from TR1; S3.alv2_t9 rebuilds the Alvarado total from the table. Weak: the key is the longest option in S3.case and S3.mech (telegraph); S3.alv is asked cold before any score is taught; S3.cl re-asks items answered minutes earlier; S3.ttr_ok packs three look-alike lists into one message.

S4.c3_t10 and S4.c3_why10 teach the imaging ladder well ('a safe first rung, then a second one'), and S4.a3 offers three traps. Weak: S4.d1, S4.c2, S4.c2b, S4.c4, S4.a1, S4.a2, S4.a5 and S4.a6 have one trap plus a hint, so a guess is 50%; S4.a5 repeats the S3.alv2 items and answer nearly verbatim; S4.d1_t9 and S4.a1_t11 loop back to the identical probe with no new teaching.

Strong management branch: S5.p1 separates TR22 from TR23 by qualifiers; S5.p3_t0 and S5.p3_w0 explain mass versus abscess; S5.p5_t1 and S5.p5_w1 explain drainage order; S5.p6_h sorts disease from operation; S5.p9 contrasts the old key with current practice. Weak: S5.p9 key is by far the longest and most nuanced option (telegraph); S5.p4 key is the longest (78 characters); S5.p5_h nearly names the answer.

Cold final has new vignettes that work: S6.p3 (Alvarado 6), S6.p6 (negative ultrasound in an adult, no hint), S6.p8 (beta-hCG first), S6.p10 (mass versus abscess), S6.p11 (two complications). But S6.p1_t1, S6.p3_t1, S6.p4_t1, S6.p5_t1, S6.p6_t1, S6.p8_t1, S6.p10_t1 and S6.p11_t1 drop the Tempting and Nudge scaffold and use the same generic sure_note ('give it a second look before you move on'); S6.p5 option 'It is a hip movement, so pressing the abdomen is wrong' is dominated; S6.p1 to S6.p5 re-run S2 and S3 probes; S6.p12_ok gives the PYQ size rule in feedback only, never as a probe.

best_parts: S3.rov and S3.rov_t3: predict where the sign presses and where it hurts, then a Nudge that makes the learner predict the pain site from the press site. Keep this predict-then-show pattern.
S4.c3_t10 and S4.c3_why10: 'Ultrasound is first; MRI is the next step when ultrasound is inconclusive', framed as a ladder with a safe first rung. Best concept-level feedback on TR10.
S3.alv2_t9 and S3.alv2_why: the learner adds item by item from the table, and the explanation shows the sum to 7 with the 'likely, not confirmed' caveat.
S5.p3_t0 and S5.p3_w0 with the S5.p3_h hint ('think about what the omentum has done by day five'): the hint reasons from the mechanism, not the answer.
flaws: S3.case (key 'Extend the right hip with him on his left side'): the key is the longest of three options, so form gives it away (DP1). Also S3.mech key is longest and echoes the stem's 'rectal tenderness'.

S5.p9 (key 'Choice is appendicectomy; only is the old key; antibiotics-first suits selected adults'): the only nuanced option, the longest by about 15 characters. Shorten the key or lengthen the traps.
S6.p5 option 'It is a hip movement, so pressing the abdomen is wrong': dominated (DP2). A learner with any surface model of Rovsing rejects it at once.
S6.p1_t1, S6.p3_t1, S6.p4_t1, S6.p5_t1, S6.p6_t1, S6.p8_t1, S6.p10_t1, S6.p11_t1: the sure_note is the same boilerplate, names no wrong model, and no feedback in S6 says why the trap is tempting.
S2.age_probe and S2.adult_probe, and S4.a5: near-repeats of S1.age_a, S1.age_b and S3.alv2. Dead weight that a tired learner notices (both sim reports say so).

S2.pain_a_2, S2.chain_probe_2, S3.case_2, S4.d1 and most '_2' nodes: 'Same question, one more look' re-asks the same stem with reordered options, so the second tap is solvable by elimination. Delayed re-tests exist (S6.p1, S6.p4) but come far too late to count as recovery.
S4.d1, S4.c2, S4.c2b, S4.c4, S4.a1, S4.a2, S4.a5, S4.a6: two real options plus a hint. Add the dropped distractors from trap-map (low-dose CT for TR9, MRI for TR11 as partial, laparoscopy for TR12).
S6.p2 stem ('She vomited twice after the pain began') states the answer; the probe checks reading, not the trap.
S6.p12 'Mucocele' is mapped to TR13, which is a severity-for-frequency trap; the option is not that error. Size rule for O12 is taught but never probed.
dp2_dominated_options: S6.p5: 'It is a hip movement, so pressing the abdomen is wrong'

novice.verdict: Accurate on which models were held; the 'weak' headline and 'gap' on O3 to O11 come from first attempts only, so a learner who corrected each item on the next tap reads as having learned nothing. No 'corrected on retry' state.

misconceived.verdict: Names the right beliefs and corrections, but miscounts: cold_right 21 of 22 contradicts 28 first-visit wrong answers, sure_wrong is understated, and every trap is 'fell_recovered' on an immediate same-stem retry, which overstates durable change. report_accurate false per the sim.

strong.verdict: Headline and secure objectives are right, but it says 'at most one shaky area' when none is shaky, its fast-lane line gives nothing to check, and the cold count (10) does not match the 11 cards without explanation.

guesser.verdict: Counts match the path, but the headline is harsh because it scores first attempts; it never says most misses were corrected on the next tap, and it never tells a fast clicker that 'Show me why' holds 15 percent of the content.

merge_ideas: Carry S3's Tempting-then-Nudge feedback and trap-specific sure_notes (S3.case_t1, S3.rov_t3) into S6, replacing the generic 'give it a second look' in the cold segment.
Replace each immediate '_2' retry with a different-surface re-test a few nodes later (S3.case_2 to a vignette in S5), so recovery counts only when it is delayed and in a new form.
Use S5.p6_h's sorting frame ('from the inflamed appendix or from the operation') as the S6.p11 hint and S6.p11_t1 repair.
Give the 2-option probes in S4 the dropped distractors from trap-map (TR9 low-dose CT, TR11 MRI as partial, TR12 laparoscopy), and cut S4.a5 and S2.age_probe in favour of a new case each.
Balance key lengths in S3.case, S3.mech, S5.p4, S5.p9 and S6.p12 by lengthening the traps to match the key's detail.
